- Vitamin A also helps skin glands make an oily substance called sebum. Sebum moisturizes the scalp and helps keep hair healthy

description:
Dandruff isn’t just about flakes - it’s one of the hidden causes of hair fall.

What does it contain?
1. 1% Ketoconazole Shampoo: Fights dandruff at the source with 1% Ketoconazole for gentle exfoliation & scalp balance
2. Biotin Hair Gummies: A daily boost of Biotin, Iron, and Zinc to support stronger hair from within

Results you can expect:

Month 1: Visible relief from flakes & itching

Month 2: Reduction in fungal growth & scalp inflammation

Month 3: Long-term dandruff control & noticeable reduction in dandruff-related hair fall

How to use:

👉 Shampoo: Dry scalp 1–2 times a week, Oily scalp 2–3 times a week

👉 Gummies: 1 gummy daily after meals

Clinically tested on Indian women. Visible results with consistent use.

✨ Consistency matters. Science that sets you free.

Ketoconazole Shampoo

Step 1: Wet your hair thoroughly with water.

Step 2: Take a sufficient amount of Be Bodywise 1% Ketoconazole Shampoo in your palm and apply directly to the scalp.

Step 3: Gently massage into your scalp. Leave for 1–2 minutes before rinsing well.
Hair Health Gummies
Take 1 gummy daily after a meal.
